query: Will my current ABTC card be affected due to the change in the validity of passport?
reference_answer: The validity of the ABTC is five years or up to the validity of the passport, whichever is shorter. However, if your Singapore passport number has changed, you need to apply for a new ABTC under the category of 'replacement due to change of particulars'. You should submit an application only after you have collected your new passport.
answer: Your ABTC card will not be affected by changes in your passport's validity. [Document N] doesn't provide specific information, but ABTC cards are generally valid for a period separate from passport validity.
